title: Convergence of a Control Volume Finite Element scheme for a cross-diffusion system modeling ion transport
summary: An approximation of a system coupling the cross-diffusion of chemical species within a solvent, subjected to an electric field, is obtained through a control volume finite element (CVFE) scheme on general simplicial meshes in two or three space dimensions. The discrete unknowns of the numerical scheme are derived from the chemical potential of the species. The scheme is designed in order to fulfill entropy inequalities, yielding compactness properties for the discrete solutions and convergence to a weak solution of the continuous problem.
